title: Iran Changed China’s Taiwan Invasion Plans
summary: A defence commentator drops his forecast of a 2027 Chinese invasion of Taiwan, arguing that the Iran war showed US strike power, China's oil vulnerability and how wars bog down, which together delay an invasion.

assertions.quote: do I still hold that opinion? Not really
there are five reasons why uh Chinese invasion of Taiwan is actually less likely due to the conflict in Iran

verdicts.note: Some analysts read the war as a demonstration of US strike power and China's oil exposure; others argue depleted US munitions raise the risk. The net effect is uncertain.

assertions.quote: I think all these factors have at least pushed back any sort of Taiwan invasion date by a few years
The war in Iran hasn't depleted our stockpiles of anti-ship missiles.
These five bases will essentially be turned into lakes of fire within about 30 minutes of the start of the war.

verdicts.note: Wargames such as CSIS's 2023 series assume early Chinese missile strikes on bases in Japan and Guam, but strikes on Korea, and how complete they would be, are less certain.
In CSIS's base scenario China struck Andersen AFB on Guam in every iteration and bases in Japan in two of three; Korea is not covered.

assertions.quote: China knows that it can't invade Taiwan if half of its ships are at the bottom of the Strait of Taiwan
When TikTok came under American control, China lost their last best source of propaganda.

verdicts.note: The US ownership deal reduces one channel, but Chinese influence operations run across many platforms, so calling TikTok the main one overreaches.

assertions.quote: China would need to rebuild their oil reserves before starting any conflict

verdicts.note: China imports most of its oil, but its large strategic stocks and Russian pipeline supply cover months of a blockade.

EFIS says China wants the Power of Siberia 2 pipeline partly to secure energy in a Taiwan conflict even under sanctions or a maritime blockade, showing Beijing treats seaborne energy dependence as a vulnerability.

assertions.quote: And all three of those countries got bogged down anyway, even with their experience.

verdicts.note: Ukraine and Gaza became long wars of attrition, but short decisive campaigns such as Azerbaijan's in 2023 still happen.

assertions.quote: they can afford to wait and and just slowly use influence operations to bring people from Taiwan over to their side
